CD8+ T cells: Tumor-infiltrating CD8+ T cells expressing cytotoxic effector molecules. CD8+ cytotoxic T lymphocytes from human lung adenocarcinoma tumor microenvironment.
Macrophages: Myeloid macrophage populations in the cancer microenvironment. Tumor-associated macrophages from human lung adenocarcinoma.
Epithelial cells: Cancer cells of epithelial origin with tumor-associated expression programs. Malignant epithelial cells from human lung adenocarcinoma.
NK cells: Innate lymphoid NK cells with cytotoxic activity in the tumor microenvironment. Natural killer cells infiltrating human lung adenocarcinoma.
